title: An app's Telegram commands (one manifest per app, owned by the app's repo)
description: Every command is '/<app> <verb> [args]'. The hub lists manifests in /help and /list, puts each app in Telegram's '/' menu, and routes '/<app> <verb>' to the app's sink.

schema.description: telefi.* is current; notifly.* is accepted while producers migrate

app.description: the command word: lowercase letters, digits, underscore

sink.description: the hub_config inbound sink that receives this app's commands

legacy_text.description: for an app that parses its old bare command: the hub forwards '/<app> <verb> x' as '<legacy_text> x'
